title: Knight Facing Dragon
description: A knight in full silver armor and a flowing red cape stands on the left holding a long sword with both hands pointed at a large purple dragon on the right. The dragon has an open mouth with the sword blade inside it while the knight looks up at the beast against a colorful painted background.
prompt: A knight in full silver armor with a long red cape stands facing a large purple dragon. The knight holds a long sword with both hands and points it directly into the open mouth of the dragon. The dragon has purple and orange scales with spikes along its back. The background is an abstract painted surface with yellow orange and purple brush strokes and paint splatters.
